_meta.purpose: Structured move effects and scripted behaviors for Zone 1 enemies, transcribed from off-campaign-bestiary.json fx/special strings and docs/off-restat-worksheet.md. Scripted triggers auto-fire for AI-controlled instances only; for GM-piloted instances they surface as prompts and never act uninvoked. Enemies outside this file resolve plain-damage moves generically; any move whose fx string is not covered here fires its damage (if any) and surfaces its fx text to the GM as a prompt — never half-implemented.

moveEffects_vocabulary.status: pure or rider status application, rolls the TARGET's tier (players: neutral tier base 80 minus RES, per the worksheet's boss examples) — 'tier' entries name the status
moveEffects_vocabulary.drainCp: [min,max] drained from the target's CP, no damage
moveEffects_vocabulary.hits: number of separate accuracy rolls / damage packets in one action
moveEffects_vocabulary.cpCost: CP the move spends (enemy CP defaults to unlimited — see build notes)
moveEffects_vocabulary.scripted: excluded from the AI's uniform-random legal move pool; fired only by triggers below

Rupture-burnt.label: Clock Out — ~22 Meat to all, then dies

Dedan.label: Half Past — Hasty until death, no cure check
